resources.string: FORMA PIC is a production-grade computational photography, DSLR manual control, and AI photo enhancement studio designed to capture natural, sharp, high-dynamic-range photos and cinematic video across compatible Android devices.

100% On-Device Privacy: All computational HDR merging, low-light noise reduction, portrait bokeh segmentation, and AI photo enhancement execute locally on your phone hardware. FORMA PIC never uploads your photos, videos, or facial data to external servers.
